body:
### Summary

Please include CPython 3.15.0 final in a released uv managed-Python catalog so that `uv python install 3.15.0` can install the stable interpreter.

[Python 3.15.0 was released on October 9, 2026](https://www.python.org/downloads/release/python-3150/), and [python-build-standalone 20261009](https://github.com/astral-sh/python-build-standalone/releases/tag/20261009) now publishes final builds. I see that [#22400](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22400) has already merged the catalog update, and [#22415](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22415) prepares uv 0.13.0 with Python 3.15.0 in its release notes. The remaining gap is availability in a published uv release.

### Current behavior

With uv 0.12.24 on macOS 27.0.1 ARM64, this isolated installation command fails:

```console
$ uv --version
uv 0.12.24 (Homebrew 2026-10-08 aarch64-apple-darwin)
$ uv --no-config python install 3.15.0 --install-dir /tmp/uv-python315-check --no-bin --verbose
DEBUG uv 0.12.24 (Homebrew 2026-10-08 aarch64-apple-darwin)
DEBUG Using request connect timeout of 10s and read timeout of 30s
error: No download found for request: cpython-3.15.0-macos-aarch64-none
```

`uv --no-config python list 3.15 --all-versions --all-platforms --all-arches` still lists 3.15.0rc3 in that release. The final interpreter is present in the current main-branch catalog, including macOS ARM64 and Linux x86_64/aarch64.

This request concerns the released managed-download catalog. It does not claim a failure to use a separately installed Python 3.15 interpreter. The related release-availability discussion is [#19788](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/issues/19788).
title: Make CPython 3.15.0 final available through the released uv managed-Python catalog
